Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National MTTD explains what motorists should know about TraffiTech-GH on Newsfile Source : Myjoyonline.com 7 November 2026 1:10pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The Director of Education at the Motor Traffic and Transport Department (MTTD), ACP Alexander Obeng, has outlined what motorists need to know about the implementation of TraffiTech-GH.
This includes their responsibilities and key requirements under the automated traffic enforcement system.
Speaking on JoyNews’ Newsfile, he addressed some of the issues surrounding the system and explained what matters most for motorists as the enforcement programme takes effect.
21 minutes of Traffitech-GH education; what you need to do, what you need to know and what matters most by ACP Alexander Obeng [Director of Education at the MTTD] #Newsfile. https://t.co/QlC7G57zXx
